subject: [RFC PATCH v3 06/14] mm/vmscan, memcontrol: Add nodemask to try_to_free_mem_cgroup_pages

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a new nodemask parameter to the try_to_free_mem_cgroup_pages function in the Linux kernel's memory management subsystem. This allows selective reclaim on specific nodes, enabling future patches to target top-tier nodes and apply downward pressure when their limits are breached but global memcg-wide limits have not yet been reached. The patch modifies several files, including mm/internal.h, mm/memcontrol-v1.c, mm/memcontrol.c, and mm/vmscan.c.
